key_highlights: ASX set to slump on Wall Street selloff driven by higher oil prices and spiking bond yields, fuelling RBA rate-hike fears
Fourth RBA interest rate hike looms as inflation remains 'home grown', with analysts forecasting 10% house price declines
Coal sector booms, gold discoveries in WA/Qld (King River 44g/t, Moonlight), and McLaren titanium grades surge support materials
CSL signs US deal to slash medicine prices under Trump administration, raising revenue-mix concerns
Qantas ground crews vote for right to strike amid pay dispute; property developer Bathla warns of imminent collapse
Geopolitical escalation: Iran threatens US with new attacks; gold sinks on safe-haven rotation
Property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes; negative gearing reform fails to ignite rent shock
Top central banker warns AI bubble could trigger global downturn; AI boom straining housing construction pipeline

sectors.trend: Bullish. Coal boom, gold discoveries (King River 44g/t WA, Moonlight Qld), McLaren titanium surge, Viking tungsten strike, Larvotto antimony. Mineral Resources ASIC investigation closed. Commodity strength offsets rate-hike headwinds.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from coal/oil strength. Gold miners (Nevada.GX, GOLD.AX) supported by WA/Qld discoveries. Tungsten/titanium names (Viking, McLaren) see exploration upside. MRL.AX cleared of ASIC overhang.

sectors.trend: Bearish. Fourth RBA hike pressures NIMs and credit growth. CBA fee controversy (13-year inactive card charges) damages reputation. Property investor credit growth crashes post-budget. Bathla developer near collapse signals credit stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression and rising NPL risk from property. Rate hikes support NIMs short-term but credit deterioration is a medium-term threat. ASX banks under pressure.

sectors.trend: Mixed. CSL signs US price-cut deal with Trump administration, capping US revenue growth. Offsets: strong domestic demand, but margin pressure from forced price reductions.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces structural US pricing headwind. Monitor deal terms for margin impact. Defensive healthcare names may attract rotation from cyclicals.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Higher oil prices support upstream but diesel shock hits transport/logistics. Big batteries midnight power raid under regulator scrutiny threatens renewable project economics.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WES.AX face input cost pressure. Battery/storage developers face regulatory risk. Coal exporters benefit from price strength.

sectors.trend: Bearish. Qantas strike risk, per-capita recession fears, housing crash reducing consumer confidence. Denny's and firearms retailer bankruptcies signal global consumer weakness.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk. WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSG.AX under pressure from weak consumer spending. Jetstar (JPA.AX) benefits from Western Sydney Airport launch.

sectors.trend: Bearish. 10% house price decline forecast, property investor credit crash, Bathla near-collapse. Negative gearing reform muted but affordability crisis persists.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face falling occupier demand and rising financing costs. Residential property developers at high distress risk.

sectors.trend: Cautionary. Top central banker warns AI could spark global downturn. AI boom straining construction workforce. Tech selloff in US (Nvidia, Apple, SMCI). Oracle bullish per Citi.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) vulnerable to global tech correction. AI infrastructure spend may peak. Oracle (ORCL) and Salesforce (CRM) diverge.

key_themes: RBA fourth rate hike and persistent home-grown inflation
Housing market correction: 10% price decline forecast, credit growth crash
Commodity super-cycle: coal, gold, titanium, tungsten strength
Geopolitical risk: Iran-US escalation, US-Canada trade war
AI bubble warning from global central bankers
Consumer recession risk: per-capita GDP contraction
Banking sector stress: fee controversies, property credit deterioration
CSL US pricing deal as structural margin headwind

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and sustained inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour fixed-income ladders; monitor CPI print closely
Underweight residential REITs and property developers; favour commercial/industrial REITs with long leases
Maintain gold allocation (GOLD.AX, WES.AX); hedge AUD/USD; diversify away from oil-dependent supply chains
Trim ASX tech exposure; favour cash-generative defensives; monitor US tech earnings (Nvidia, Apple)
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor for contagion to other transport/aviation names
Avoid distressed property equities; monitor bank NPL disclosures for property exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: CSL US price-cut deal margin erosion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reassess CSL.AX valuation on revised US revenue assumptions; favour domestic-focused healthcare

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and base metals miners on commodity strength and geopolitical hedge
opportunities.rationale: Coal boom, gold discoveries (King River, Moonlight), titanium/tungsten strikes, and Iran-US risk support metals prices

opportunities.recommendation: Add Mineral Resources on ASIC clearance
opportunities.rationale: ASIC investigation declared over with no action for Ellison; removes overhang on lithium/energy transition play

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to Jetstar on Western Sydney Airport launch
opportunities.rationale: New airport capacity supports JPA.AX revenue growth; early first flight signals operational readiness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and residential property exposure ahead of 10% price correction
defensive_moves.rationale: Credit growth crash, Bathla distress, and rate hikes create downside risk for property-linked equities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration bonds and gold allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth RBA hike and spiking yields pressure equities; gold and short bonds offer relative safety

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim ASX tech and AI-exposed names on central-bank warning
defensive_moves.rationale: Top central banker flags AI contagion risk; US tech selloff (Nvidia, Apple, SMCI) may transmit to ASX

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Qantas near-term on strike risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground crew strike vote creates operational and earnings uncertainty

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to open lower on Wall Street selloff, oil-driven inflation fears, and RBA hike expectations. Materials outperform on commodity strength; financials, REITs, and consumer lag. Volatility elevated on Iran-US tensions and AI contagion warnings. Expect ^AXJO to test support levels.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive for materials and energy; cautious for property and consumer. Housing correction may be 10%+ but negative gearing reform muted limits downside. Coal and gold structural demand supports miners. CSL US deal is a one-off margin hit. AI capex cycle may peak, creating rotation opportunity into value/defensives. Per-capita recession risk is the key macro overhang.
key_catalysts: CSL US deal terms and margin impact
Property developer credit stress (Bathla and peers)
watch_list: Iron ore, coal, gold, LNG spot prices
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
CPI, retail sales, housing credit data
QAN.AX share price on strike developments
Bathla and property developer credit flows
